q: By December 31, 2026, Polish military authorities officially announce that a manned Russian or Belarusian military aircraft has again violated Polish airspace (only incidents after October 10, 2026, count)
basis: On September 23, 2026, a Russian Mi-8 helicopter that had taken off from Kaliningrad flew about 300 meters into Polish airspace and stayed there for 42 seconds. It was the first publicly reported case of a Russian military helicopter crossing Poland's land border. The day before, Polish fighter jets intercepted a Russian Il-20 reconnaissance aircraft that had come close to the coast (outside Polish airspace).
rs: An official statement by the Polish Armed Forces Operational Command or the Polish Ministry of National Defence
